accounting_reconciliation.label: Accounting reconciliation entry
accounting_reconciliation.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "j1"."move_id" AS "debit_document",
  "j2"."move_id" AS "credit_document",
  "j3"."payment_id" AS "debit_payment",
  "j4"."payment_id" AS "credit_payment",
  "b"."amount" AS "matched_amount"
FROM "account_partial_reconcile" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "account_move_line" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."debit_move_id"
LEFT JOIN "account_move_line" AS "j2" ON "j2"."id" = "b"."credit_move_id"
LEFT JOIN "account_move" AS "j3" ON "j3"."id" = "j1"."move_id"
LEFT JOIN "account_move" AS "j4" ON "j4"."id" = "j2"."move_id"

billing_document.label: Posted invoice, bill or credit note
billing_document.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "document_number",
  "b"."state" AS "document_state",
  "b"."move_type" AS "document_type",
  "b"."invoice_date" AS "billing_date",
  "b"."invoice_date_due" AS "due_date",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "billing_partner",
  "b"."company_id" AS "billing_company",
  "j1"."currency_id" AS "company_currency",
  "b"."payment_state" AS "settlement_status",
  "b"."amount_untaxed_signed" AS "untaxed_signed",
  "b"."amount_residual_signed" AS "residual_signed"
FROM "account_move" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "res_company" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."company_id"
WHERE ("b"."state" = 'posted') AND ("b"."move_type" IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund'))

billing_line.label: Posted invoice or bill line
billing_line.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."move_id" AS "line_document",
  "j1"."state" AS "line_document_state",
  "j1"."move_type" AS "line_document_type",
  "b"."display_type" AS "line_display_type",
  "b"."product_id" AS "billed_product",
  "b"."purchase_line_id" AS "billed_purchase_line"
FROM "account_move_line" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "account_move" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."move_id"
WHERE ("j1"."state" = 'posted') AND ("j1"."move_type" IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund')) AND ("b"."display_type" = 'product')

company.label: Company
company.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "name",
  "b"."parent_id" AS "parent"
FROM "res_company" AS "b"

crm_opportunity.label: CRM opportunity
crm_opportunity.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "opportunity_name",
  "b"."type" AS "lead_kind",
  "b"."active" AS "opportunity_active",
  "b"."stage_id" AS "opportunity_stage",
  "b"."team_id" AS "opportunity_team",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "opportunity_contact",
  "b"."company_id" AS "opportunity_company",
  "b"."create_date" AS "opportunity_created",
  "b"."date_deadline" AS "expected_close",
  "b"."expected_revenue" AS "expected_value"
FROM "crm_lead" AS "b"
WHERE ("b"."type" = 'opportunity')

location.label: Stock location
location.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."complete_name" AS "location_name",
  "b"."usage" AS "usage",
  "b"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."location_id" AS "parent",
  "b"."scrap_location" AS "scrap_flag",
  "b"."return_location" AS "return_flag"
FROM "stock_location" AS "b"

partner.label: Contact
partner.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "name",
  "b"."customer_rank" AS "customer_rank",
  "b"."supplier_rank" AS "supplier_rank",
  "b"."employee" AS "employee"
FROM "res_partner" AS "b"

pos_order.label: POS order
pos_order.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "receipt_number",
  "b"."date_order" AS "order_time",
  "b"."session_id" AS "session",
  "j1"."config_id" AS "till",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "customer",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."state" AS "order_status",
  "b"."amount_total" AS "total"
FROM "pos_order" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "pos_session" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."session_id"
WHERE ("b"."state" IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced'))

pos_order_line.label: POS order line
pos_order_line.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."order_id" AS "order",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "j1"."date_order" AS "order_time",
  "j2"."config_id" AS "till",
  "j1"."session_id" AS "session",
  "j1"."state" AS "order_status",
  "b"."qty" AS "quantity",
  "b"."price_unit" AS "unit_price",
  "b"."price_subtotal" AS "net_amount",
  "b"."price_subtotal_incl" AS "gross_amount",
  "b"."total_cost" AS "cost"
FROM "pos_order_line" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "pos_order" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."order_id"
LEFT JOIN "pos_session" AS "j2" ON "j2"."id" = "j1"."session_id"
WHERE ("j1"."state" IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced'))

pos_session.label: POS session
pos_session.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "session_name",
  "b"."config_id" AS "till",
  "b"."start_at" AS "opened_at",
  "b"."stop_at" AS "closed_at",
  "b"."state" AS "session_status",
  "b"."user_id" AS "cashier"
FROM "pos_session" AS "b"

posted_payment.label: Posted payment
posted_payment.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "j1"."state" AS "payment_posting_state",
  "j1"."date" AS "paid_date",
  "b"."payment_type" AS "payment_direction",
  "b"."partner_type" AS "payment_partner_type",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "payment_partner",
  "j1"."company_id" AS "payment_company",
  "b"."currency_id" AS "payment_currency",
  "b"."amount" AS "payment_amount"
FROM "account_payment" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "account_move" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."move_id"
WHERE ("j1"."state" = 'posted')

product.label: Product
product.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."default_code" AS "code",
  "j1"."name" AS "name",
  "j1"."categ_id" AS "category",
  "j1"."type" AS "product_type",
  "j1"."uom_id" AS "uom",
  "j1"."list_price" AS "sales_price"
FROM "product_product" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "product_template" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."product_tmpl_id"
WHERE ("j1"."type" = 'product')

product_category.label: Product category
product_category.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "name",
  "b"."complete_name" AS "full_name",
  "b"."parent_id" AS "parent"
FROM "product_category" AS "b"

purchase_order.label: Purchase order
purchase_order.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "po_number",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "supplier",
  "b"."date_order" AS "order_date",
  "b"."date_approve" AS "approval_date",
  "b"."date_planned" AS "expected_date",
  "b"."effective_date" AS "first_receipt_date",
  "b"."state" AS "po_status",
  "b"."receipt_status" AS "receipt_status",
  "b"."user_id" AS "buyer",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company"
FROM "purchase_order" AS "b"

purchase_order_line.label: Purchase order line
purchase_order_line.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."order_id" AS "order",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "supplier",
  "b"."state" AS "line_status",
  "b"."date_planned" AS "expected_date",
  "j1"."date_approve" AS "confirmation_date",
  "j1"."currency_id" AS "purchase_currency",
  "b"."product_qty" AS "qty_ordered",
  "b"."qty_received" AS "qty_received",
  "b"."price_unit" AS "unit_price",
  "b"."price_subtotal" AS "line_value",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company"
FROM "purchase_order_line" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "purchase_order" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."order_id"
WHERE ("b"."state" <> 'cancel')

sales_order.label: Sales order
sales_order.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "order_number",
  "b"."date_order" AS "order_date",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "customer",
  "b"."user_id" AS "salesperson",
  "b"."team_id" AS "sales_team",
  "b"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."state" AS "order_status",
  "b"."amount_total" AS "total",
  "b"."amount_untaxed" AS "untaxed_total"
FROM "sale_order" AS "b"
WHERE ("b"."state" IN ('sale', 'done'))

sales_order_line.label: Sales order line
sales_order_line.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."order_id" AS "order",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "j3"."categ_id" AS "product_category",
  "b"."order_partner_id" AS "customer",
  "j1"."team_id" AS "sales_team",
  "j1"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."currency_id" AS "currency",
  "b"."product_uom" AS "ordered_uom",
  "j1"."date_order" AS "order_date",
  "j1"."state" AS "order_status",
  "b"."product_uom_qty" AS "quantity",
  "b"."price_unit" AS "price",
  "b"."price_subtotal" AS "net_amount",
  "b"."price_total" AS "tax_included_amount",
  "b"."purchase_price" AS "unit_cost"
FROM "sale_order_line" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "sale_order" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."order_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_product" AS "j2" ON "j2"."id" = "b"."product_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_template" AS "j3" ON "j3"."id" = "j2"."product_tmpl_id"
WHERE ("j1"."state" IN ('sale', 'done'))

scrap.label: Scrap
scrap.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."state" AS "scrap_status",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "b"."date_done" AS "scrap_date",
  "b"."scrap_qty" AS "scrap_quantity",
  "b"."location_id" AS "source_location",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company"
FROM "stock_scrap" AS "b"
WHERE ("b"."state" = 'done')

stock_lot.label: Lot
stock_lot.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "lot_number",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "b"."expiration_date" AS "expiry_date",
  "b"."use_date" AS "best_before",
  "b"."removal_date" AS "removal_date",
  "b"."alert_date" AS "alert_date"
FROM "stock_lot" AS "b"

stock_move.label: Stock move
stock_move.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."state" AS "move_status",
  "b"."date" AS "move_date",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "j1"."code" AS "operation_code",
  "b"."location_id" AS "source_location",
  "b"."location_dest_id" AS "destination_location",
  "b"."quantity_done" AS "done_quantity",
  "b"."product_uom_qty" AS "demand_quantity",
  "b"."is_inventory" AS "inventory_adjustment",
  "b"."scrapped" AS "scrapped",
  "b"."picking_id" AS "picking",
  "b"."purchase_line_id" AS "purchase_line",
  "b"."sale_line_id" AS "sales_line",
  "b"."picking_type_id" AS "operation_type_ref"
FROM "stock_move" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "stock_picking_type" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."picking_type_id"
WHERE ("b"."state" = 'done')

stock_movement_detail.label: Completed stock move line
stock_movement_detail.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "j1"."state" AS "detail_state",
  "b"."date" AS "movement_date",
  "b"."move_id" AS "movement",
  "b"."product_id" AS "movement_product",
  "b"."lot_id" AS "movement_lot",
  "b"."location_id" AS "movement_from",
  "b"."location_dest_id" AS "movement_to",
  "b"."product_uom_id" AS "movement_uom",
  "b"."qty_done" AS "processed_quantity"
FROM "stock_move_line" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "stock_move" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."move_id"
WHERE ("j1"."state" = 'done')

stock_position.label: Stock position
stock_position.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "j3"."categ_id" AS "product_category",
  "j3"."uom_id" AS "stock_uom",
  "b"."location_id" AS "location",
  "j1"."usage" AS "location_usage",
  "j4"."role" AS "location_role",
  "j1"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."lot_id" AS "lot",
  "j5"."expiration_date" AS "expiry_date",
  "b"."in_date" AS "received_on",
  "b"."inventory_quantity_set" AS "counted",
  "b"."quantity" AS "quantity",
  "b"."reserved_quantity" AS "reserved_quantity",
  "b"."inventory_diff_quantity" AS "count_diff"
FROM "stock_quant" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "stock_location" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."location_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_product" AS "j2" ON "j2"."id" = "b"."product_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_template" AS "j3" ON "j3"."id" = "j2"."product_tmpl_id"
LEFT JOIN "onto_org_map" AS "j4" ON "j4"."location_id" = "b"."location_id"
LEFT JOIN "stock_lot" AS "j5" ON "j5"."id" = "b"."lot_id"
WHERE ("j1"."usage" IN ('internal', 'transit'))

stock_valuation.label: Stock valuation layer
stock_valuation.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."create_date" AS "layer_date",
  "b"."quantity" AS "layer_quantity",
  "b"."value" AS "value",
  "b"."remaining_qty" AS "remaining_quantity",
  "b"."remaining_value" AS "remaining_value",
  "b"."unit_cost" AS "unit_cost",
  "b"."stock_move_id" AS "layer_move",
  "j1"."scrapped" AS "scrapped"
FROM "stock_valuation_layer" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "stock_move" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."stock_move_id"

supplier_info.label: Supplier price and lead time
supplier_info.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "supplier",
  "b"."product_tmpl_id" AS "product_template",
  "b"."product_id" AS "product",
  "b"."min_qty" AS "min_order_qty",
  "b"."price" AS "supplier_price",
  "b"."delay" AS "lead_time_days",
  "b"."date_start" AS "valid_from",
  "b"."date_end" AS "valid_to",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company"
FROM "product_supplierinfo" AS "b"

transfer.label: Transfer
transfer.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "reference",
  "b"."state" AS "transfer_status",
  "j1"."code" AS "operation_code",
  "j1"."sequence_code" AS "operation_sequence",
  "b"."scheduled_date" AS "scheduled_date",
  "b"."date_done" AS "done_date",
  "b"."partner_id" AS "partner",
  "j1"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse",
  "b"."location_id" AS "source_location",
  "b"."location_dest_id" AS "destination_location",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company"
FROM "stock_picking" AS "b"
LEFT JOIN "stock_picking_type" AS "j1" ON "j1"."id" = "b"."picking_type_id"

warehouse.label: Warehouse
warehouse.sql:
SELECT
  "b"."id" AS "_onto_id",
  "b"."name" AS "warehouse_name",
  "b"."code" AS "warehouse_code",
  "b"."company_id" AS "company",
  "b"."lot_stock_id" AS "main_location",
  "b"."view_location_id" AS "view_location",
  "b"."reception_steps" AS "reception_steps"
FROM "stock_warehouse" AS "b"
